case_title: COLOMBINI, RUDY VS WELLS FARGO BANK

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,130.90 FILED BY COLOMBINI, RUDY AS TO DEFENDANT WELLS FARGO BANK ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-17-1994 AT 05:30 PM IN DEPT 01

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF COLOMBINI, RUDY RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT WELLS FARGO BANK $1,092.90 PRINCIPAL, $15.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,107.90 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
